headlines.title: PayPal Just Put Agent Checkout on 60 Million Living Room Screens. The Merchant Liability Wall Did Not Get the Memo.
headlines.summary: The Ambient Checkout Frontier The transition of agentic commerce from the controlled environment of a smartphone screen to the ambient surfaces of the home and pocket is now underway. On October 15, 2026, PayPal and Glance announced an integration that embeds native checkout directly into the Glance ecosystem.

headlines.title: Is PayPal's Next Big Thing Already Here?
headlines.summary: A reported $60.50-a-share offer from Stripe and Advent in July lifted PayPal (PYPL) stock, but the bidders walked away in late August without a deal, according to Bloomberg. Without a buyer, investors need a catalyst from the business itself, and that is difficult to find given that branded checkout, where shoppers pay with PayPal online, recorded just 2% growth in payment volume during fiscal Q2 2026.

headlines.title: What Is PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Gaining From Its First Major AI Commerce Rollout?
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) and Glance announced a new partnership integrating PayPal agentic commerce tools into the Glance platform for U.S. users. The tie up brings AI powered native checkout and real time product data directly into Glance for tens of millions of consumers in the United States. Merchants gain a new way to reach Glance users through PayPal, extending PayPal's platform agnostic payment reach inside an AI driven shopping experience.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
